description: Fields the AI must fill per page using this template. Use this as the source of truth when generating copy.

h1.guidance:
Main hero headline. ALL CAPS. Benefit-driven. 2 lines (use a
mid-way). Speaks directly to the searcher's intent.

h1_sub.guidance: Italic subhead in parens, addresses the objection. Pattern: '(Without the X, Y, or Z)'. Example: '(Without the Fear, Shame, or Awkward Lectures)'.

hero_body.guidance: Single sentence under hero. Spell out the transformation in plain words. The 'becoming the X' or 'system to do Y' phrasing works well.

cta_text.guidance: Primary button text. Action-driven, often includes the offer/price. Example: 'START THE CONVERSATION ($197 $99 TODAY)'.

gold_standard_intro.guidance: The big yellow-section paragraph. Pattern: 'Wherever your X first learns about Y, that becomes their Z'. Establishes authority anchor.

gold_standard_options.guidance: Always exactly 4. First 3 are negative options (with X-icon), last is positive ('Or You?' style — gets check icon). Each is short — 2-4 words.

gold_standard_truth.guidance: Starts with bold 'The Truth:' (in accent color). Brief paragraph that names the inadequacy parents/users feel and reframes it.

myth_title.guidance: 'X is a Myth' or similar reframing headline. Sets up the 3-column comparison.

schema.title: string (e.g., 'Old Way:', 'New Way:', 'The Goal:')
schema.icon: string — chat | refresh | heart | OR a Heroicon name

myth_columns.guidance: 3 columns. Pattern: Old Way / New Way / The Goal. Old Way describes pain, New Way describes the alternative, The Goal describes the destination outcome.

intro_banner_title.guidance: The product/course name in big yellow letters on green. Format with a colon + line break — e.g., 'Brand Name: Page Topic'.

course_intro_h3.guidance: ALL-CAPS uppercase intro to the offer. Format pattern: 'AN N-EPISODE/STEP/MODULE [thing] FOR [audience]'.

course_intro_body.guidance: 1-2 sentences. What makes this offer different from competitors. Often contrasts a generic 'just X' with the deeper 'X + Y'.

core_philosophy_body.guidance: 2-3 sentences explaining the underlying belief/worldview. Goes beyond features into meaning.

roadmap_title.guidance: 'Your Roadmap to X' style — names the destination.

schema.title: string, max 12 words — episode/module title with optional duration
schema.body: string, max 25 words — hook line teasing the value

roadmap_items.guidance: Numbered curriculum. Each item: pattern 'Episode N: [Compelling Question]? (X minutes)' or 'Step N: [Outcome]'. Body teases the takeaway, not just lists topics.

guides_image.guidance: Path or URL to photo of the instructors. Usually a 2-person or team photo. If not provided, ask the user for one.

schema.name: string — REAL person's name (do NOT fabricate)

guides_items.guidance: ALWAYS ask the user for real names + bios. Don't invent. Each entry is short — name + 1-line credibility marker.

schema.name: string — REAL person's name
schema.photo_url: string — URL or path to their photo

experts.guidance: Optional social proof row. Real names + photos only. If client doesn't have any guest experts, set to empty array — the section can hide.

pricing_section_title.guidance: 'Equip Yourself Today', 'Join Now', 'Get Started Today' style.

schema.title: string, max 5 words (with colon, e.g., '8 Video Episodes:')
schema.icon: string — play | file | calendar | star | etc.

pricing_bullets.guidance: Left column of the pricing card. Concrete deliverables (videos, guides, access duration). Each is short.

pricing_bonus_items.guidance: Right column of pricing card. Optional bonus content.

total_value.guidance: Crossed-out 'value' price. Format: '$197'. ASK THE USER for actual numbers — do not invent.

your_price.guidance: Actual selling price. Format: '$99'. ASK THE USER.

pricing_tagline.guidance: Italic emotional statement under the prices. 1 sentence. About the mission, not the offer.

pricing_button_text.guidance: CTA button in pricing card. Pattern: 'Action — $99' (with em dash).

schema.q: string — the question, asked from the prospect's POV (max 15 words)

faqs.guidance: Address the top 3-5 objections. Use real anxieties from the audience. Tone: warm, direct, reassuring. HTML <em> tags allowed in answers for emphasis.

final_cta_title.guidance: Big light-weight (300 weight) yellow heading. Emotional. 2 lines. Pattern: '[Inaction Problem] Is/Was [Outcome].' or 'Your Silence Is An Answer.'

final_cta_subtitle.guidance: ALL-CAPS bold tagline below final CTA title. Calls them to action with imperatives.

final_cta_button.guidance: Final button text. Often: 'Join The Course $197 $99'.

meta_description.guidance: SEO meta description. Includes the keyword naturally. Sells the click.
